lines.text: A short while later...
We finish our preparations and meet back at the hideout.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Time to get going! But first...

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: What's your plan, Instructor?
Huh?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: We're splitting up into three groups, but there's only one of you.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Were you just planning to take it easy?
N-not exactly...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: We'll share our findings afterwards anyway, so choose whichever appeals to you, Monsieur.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Everyone's already where they're most effective.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Even so, I think the investigation will go more smoothly if you accompany one of us.
Okay.
Which group should I join?
Go with Phantom, Yukiko, and Teddie.
Go with Miranda and Aigis.
Go with Quency, Queen, and Mona.
I don't know exactly how Teddie's ability works,
but the most effective way to find out what kind of person the man is would be to investigate his background and personal records.
I'll help with your research.
After all, I probably know more about him than anyone else.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Very well. Let's be on our way, then.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Whoa... This library is huge...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's the largest in the Ark.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It also happens to be where I work.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: You work here...? Are you a librarian?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: What? You mean being a phantom thief wasn't your day job?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This may sound rather strange, but I, too, am a phantom thief.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: You're also a phantom thief...?

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Pfft...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: A phantom thief telling phantom tales...!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Hehehe...! Ahahaha...!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Yuki-chan...
Yukiko is doubled over with laughter. It's completely unlike her...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Haa... S-sorry. I couldn't help myself... But that's beside the point.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I had no idea Phantom was a librarian. I'm surprised.
It's definitely true.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I-I see.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This way, please.
Phantom guides us into the reading room.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: This is where we keep the records of everyone who has served in the Central Government.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The information isn't especially detailed, but it should suffice as a starting point.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Monsieur, do you remember the name of the Central Government official who worked with that man?
Uh...

lines.speaker: strictmaleguest
lines.text: Brian's the one backing you, isn't he?

lines.speaker: strictmaleguest
lines.text: I work in the department next door, so I've heard a few things.

lines.speaker: strictmaleguest
lines.text: Your friend is scheduled for an audit next week.

lines.speaker: verygentleman
lines.text: H-huh...?

lines.speaker: strictmaleguest
lines.text: There's a limit to how much you can rip people off.

lines.speaker: strictmaleguest
lines.text: You've all gone way too far.
I think it was... Brian.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: One moment, please.
Phantom pulls out a book and flips through it.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Here he is. So he's with the Finance Department.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Do you happen to know that man's name as well?
Um... I don't know.
Oh, I think he owned a company called the Sustainable Future Planning Support Office or something like that.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Th-that's a strange name.
Yeah, I remembered it because it was unusual.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: With a clue like that, we should be able to find him in no time.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It even details this Brian fellow's line of work.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Then Teddie and I will look into that.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Very well. Then Monsieur and I shall investigate Sustainable Future...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: ... We shall investigate that company.
Sure.
A short while later...
As we're going through the research materials, Teddie walks over to me.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: You wouldn't happen to have any magazines around here, do you?
Huh? I think so.
Teddie takes a step closer and lowers his voice.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Not just any magazines... Do you have any... secret stuff?
I discreetly glance over at Phantom and Yukiko.
Fortunately, they seem absorbed in their research.
... Of course.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Oho! I knew you'd know, fur sure!
... Just follow me quietly.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Got it!
Teddie and I quietly make our way deeper into the reading room.
And there it is...
Here.
This is the treasure trove I stumbled upon last time.
In the fashion magazine corner of the reading room,
every issue of this prestigious magazine, with decades of history behind it, can be found here.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Ooh! This is truly a treasure trove... beyond my wildest dreams!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Hoho... I'm in absolute bliss...
I smile as I watch Teddie pore over a magazine.
*Flip*
It's been a while since we came all the way here, so I think I'll take a little break too...
Huh?
The magazine I pick up happens to be a men's fitness magazine...
Inside, a muscular male model is passionately raving about his muscles.
Did Phantom put this away in the wrong place?
Footsteps approach.
I'm so surprised by the unexpected magazine that I fail to notice.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Commander, I found something about that man...
Yukiko's gaze falls on the magazine in my hands.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Muscley men...? Commander, I really don't think you'll find the information we're looking for there...
I-I wasn't slacking off.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I can't really blame you. I stopped to read an interesting book myself earlier...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: But don't slack off too much, okay, Commander?

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Look at those bulging muscles... I'm so jealous!
I return to the reference section so nobody thinks I'm slacking off...
After a bit of a commotion, we eventually gather enough information about the man and return to our hideout.
... Miranda has a habit of doing things beyond imagination, so I doubt Aigis can handle her alone.
To prevent any accidents... No,
to at least clean up after them, I decide to go with them.
We return to the Ark and make our way to the Central Government building.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: So this is where the Central Government's key agencies are located.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: That's right! I haven't been here in a while either!
Yeah, same here...

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Really? I was under the impression that you were a soldier with the Central Government.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Don't you have to report for duty every day?
I do technically belong to the Central Government, but... how do I put it?
I'm in a special ops unit that usually operates independently, so I don't really have to come here very often.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Oh!
Miranda spots someone and runs over.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Do you—Ah.
... Then she comes running back.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Commander! What's the name of the person who worked with that guy?
Brian.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Thank you! My leader told me before, but it totally slipped my mind!
... Your leader?
After Miranda runs off again, I turn to look at Aigis,
only to find that she has somehow struck up a conversation with a familiar face.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: You're looking for some suspicious guy in the Central Government...? How am I supposed to identify him from just that?

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Fair point...

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: At the very least, go find out his name.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Hold it, I don't think I've seen you before... Huh?
Yulha's gaze lands on me.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: What's this? Newbie, is she with you?
Hey there. How are you?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: I've been better.
Yulha rubs her eyes.
What happened?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: There's the whole Outer Rim lockdown,

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: and then that massive corruption scandal they uncovered recently.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: The supervision department's been turned upside down, and now we're dealing with the fallout too.
Miranda comes running back to us again.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Is that guy's name Brian?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: The hell? How'd you know that?
We're investigating him too.
Well, not him exactly. But the guy he made a deal with...

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: My leader already told me!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: But I forgot, so the Commander reminded me!

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Your leader?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: That's right! He's the head of the supervision department!

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Why would that person even tell you?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Because I asked!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I asked him to tell me more, but he said he couldn't!
Oh...
Her words remind me of the unbelievable fact that Miranda is actually an inspector from the supervision department, secretly assigned to the police station.
... Well, as unbelievable as that sounds.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Is your leader a Nikke too?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Negative! He's a human!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Oh, and officially, I'm listed as human too!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Because it's a secret that I'm a Nikke!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Is it all right for me to know?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yes! We're friends now, so it's okay!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: It's a great honor... to become friends with you.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: The honor's mine!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I don't mind, but... are you close with those people as well? They may have overheard us.
Aigis points to a small group of people nearby, whispering among themselves as they stare at us.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Oh no! This is bad!

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: I'm going to lose my mind if I have to keep listening to this. You do something about it.
O-okay...

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: So you're with the supervision department...

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Miranda.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Can you get in touch with your leader?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yes! He said I could call anytime!

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Then call him. Tell him I sent you,

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: and tell him to hand over what I asked for.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Oh, and tell him he'd better do it before I have to come get it myself.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Once that's done, I'll send you the files on Brian.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Roger that!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Mission complete.
Is it okay to talk to the supervision department that way?

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: This never would've happened if they'd handled it properly.
O-okay.
To my surprise, Yulha receives a call from the supervision department almost immediately and hands us the documents on Brian.
Since everything wraps up so easily, I make the foolish decision to give Aigis a tour of the government building.
After Miranda drags Aigis off, I lose track of them and spend the rest of the time running around apologizing for them and cleaning up after them...
Quency may be with them, but meeting people from the underworld is still risky.
Hence, I decide to join them and watch their backs.
*Splash*
We arrive in a back alley where the ground is covered in puddles.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: So the Ark has this sort of place too.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: It's not as bad as the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: but people are pretty much the same wherever you go.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Oh, hang on a sec.
As Quency walks forward, a hooded figure emerges from the alley's shadows.
They hand her a small USB drive before disappearing.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Ta-da!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: They're already gone...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: That's rather anticlimactic...

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: People here like to get things done fast.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Tell 'em what you need, give 'em what they want, and you're good to go!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Looks like we won't be getting much action as your bodyguards.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Let's stop by Ade's on the way back.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: We can grab some dessert or something, hehe—huh?
Mona stops mid-turn.
I follow suit and turn to look.
In the direction we came from, there's a pair of black bunny ears poking out from behind a trash can.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: What the...? Are those... bunny ears?
All of a sudden,
they start twitching.
Who's... there?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Mrawr?!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Wait... You're Ade-san, aren't you?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Hahaha, what's with the outfit?
H-hi.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Hello... Master...
What's going on?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: W-well...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I was worried about you, Master... so I discreetly followed you to ensure your safety...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Wait, aren't you a maid?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: That outfit's way too stylish to be a maid uniform...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Is that a phantom thief outfit...? No, a bunny girl outfit...? Don't tell me you've got a side job?!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I've simply got into the habit of dressing like this... whenever I'm on a secret mission...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: A secret mission?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Yes... I do agent work from time to time...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Wait, so what you said before was actually true?!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: I... I'm surprised.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Then again, after seeing how you move, I guess it shouldn't be that surprising that you can keep up with us, but...
Queen looks at me.
Believe it or not, it's true.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Every now and then, I'd hear rumors about a bunny girl clumsily sneaking around the Outpost.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: So it was you all along, Ade!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: U-um...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: W-w-well, it looks like everything's been sorted, so I'll be off now...!
*Fwip*
Ade fires a rope from the device on her wrist toward the side of a building.
*Thunk*
The rope doesn't catch on the wall and falls to the ground.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I-It's simply that...

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: This is rather different from where I trained...!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: You actually trained for this? You're the real deal!
Mona approaches Ade and examines the device on her wrist and the rope.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: That's a pretty small gadget! I'm impressed you can get around with something like that.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Our leader uses a wire to zip through the air sometimes, too! So how strong is that rope?

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: It's made from an advanced material, so even if we hang from it in our combat bodies,

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: it can withstand maximum tension without any problems.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Combat bodies?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Right! Since you're Nikkes, you can swap bodies. I bet a combat body weighs a ton...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Heh heh. If it's that durable, I bet it's useful for all kinds of things! You don't happen to have any other secret weapons, do you?!

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Er... I do have a few things, I suppose...
Ade does her best to cover herself up while gauging my reaction.
... We're done here. Let's head back and talk there.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: All right... I'd like to get changed first...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Right. I know you're curious, Mona, but let's wait until we're back to talk about it.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: I'll go over the materials in the meantime.
After returning to the cafe together,
Ade changes out of her outfit, regains her composure, and spends some time chatting with Mona.
Later that night, everyone gathers at the hideout.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Great work, everyone!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Anyone run into any trouble?

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Nope! I had lots of fun!
Good work, guys.
Let's take a short break, then share what we found.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Is anyone else hungry?

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I could make us something simple—

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Y-Yuki-chan! You're exhausted from all that investigating!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: No pushing yourself too hard! It's for-bear-den!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: No, I'm not that tired.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: If anything, Phantom-san's been the one helping me this whole time, so I want to help everyone too!
Umm... Well, if you don't mind...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Of course not!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Just give me a minute. I'll get everything ready.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Oh, and Teddie, I'd love your help chopping the vegetables and stuff.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Wait, hang on! Yuki-chan?!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Aaaah!
Teddie gets dragged away by Yukiko.
What's gotten into him?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: I think Yukiko said her family runs an inn.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: I bet she's a really good cook.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Maybe she'll serve us a huge platter of fresh sashimi!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Don't you think that's expecting a bit much, Mona? I get your excitement, though. I'm looking forward to it too.
As we chat and look forward to Yukiko's cooking,
we have no idea what the future has in store for us.
